title: fix: camelCase ↔ snake_case field name mapping in ObjectQL adapter
body:
better-auth queries using camelCase field names (`providerId`, `accountId`) but ObjectStack schemas define snake_case (`provider_id`, `account_id`). The adapter had no field name conversion, so sign-in queries never matched stored records → `Credential account not found`.

### Changes

- **Added `toSnakeCase` / `toCamelCase` converters** — pure regex, no new dependencies
- **Write paths** (camelCase → snake_case): `convertWhere` field names, `create`/`update`/`updateMany` data keys, `findOne` select fields, `findMany` sortBy field
- **Read paths** (snake_case → camelCase): return values from `create`, `findOne`, `findMany`, `update`
- **Tests**: 14 new tests covering conversion functions and the exact sign-in query pattern (`findOne` by `providerId` + `accountId`)

```typescript
// Before: field names passed through as-is — query misses
filter: { providerId: 'credential', accountId: 'u1' }  // ✗ no match

// After: automatic conversion
filter: { provider_id: 'credential', account_id: 'u1' } // ✓ matches stored data
```

> 
> ### 现象与分析
> - 注册和登录流程后，账号数据被正确存入数据库，且字段名为 camelCase（如 providerId, accountId）。
> - ObjectStack 的 auth-account.object.ts schema 定义字段为 snake_case：provider_id, account_id。
> - Better-auth 查询时使用 camelCase 字段，ObjectQL adapter 无字段名转换，因此 findOne/filter 查询不能正确匹配。
> 
> **导致登录时无法查找正确的账号记录，出现 'Credential account not found' 错误。**
> 
> ### 期待行为
> - ObjectQL adapter 在写入和查询时应实现 camelCase ↔ snake_case 字段名自动转换，保证数据读写一致。
> - 登录流程可正确查找账号，不再出现 'Credential account not found'。
> 
> ### 解决建议
> - 在 objectql-adapter.ts 的 convertWhere 和相关读写函数中增加字段名转换实现。
> - 可参考 [lodash.camelCase/snakeCase](https://lodash.com/docs/4.17.15#camelCase) 实现双向映射。
>
